Name: BFAV - Don't Sell Special Chickens
Author: bikinavisho
Description:
Have you ever noticed that, when trying to buy chickens with BFAV installed, you sometimes get the option to buy a Golden Chicken at the start of the game?? Well no more of that!! With this mod installed alongside BFAV, you will no longer be able to buy Void, Blue, or Golden Chickens from Marnie's shop. 


[b]Requires[/b]: BFAV (Better Farm Animal Variety)

Install Instructions: 
[list=1]
[*]Download
[*]Extract in Mods folder
[*]Play!
[/list]

Manifest.Name: (BFAV) BikiFae's No Special Chickens
Manifest.Description: Removes special chickens such as blue and golden chickens from  Marnie's shop.
Manifest.Author: BikiFae
